bootstrap: npm install && cd web && npm install
verify_fast: cd web && npm run lint && npm run build
verify_full: cd web && npm run lint && npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 E2E_BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3012} npm exec playwright test e2e/investor.spec.ts e2e/deep-dive-story.spec.ts e2e/radar-layering.spec.ts --reporter=line
e2e: cd web && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 E2E_BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3012} npm exec playwright test e2e/investor.spec.ts e2e/deep-dive-story.spec.ts e2e/radar-layering.spec.ts --reporter=line
migration: Manual only: apply a single reviewed migration to Supabase; never run npm run db:migrate without explicit approval.
release_check: npm run audit:recommendation-gates && npm run audit:valuation-sanity && npm run audit:revaluation-loop && npm run audit:radar-live-availability && npm run audit:source-health && npm run audit:api-payload-size && npm run audit:supabase-egress-risk
deploy: Manual only: Vercel preview/production deploy requires explicit user approval after loop-release.
note: StockInsider Loop commands use real project checks. Loop release evaluates readiness only; it must not auto-merge, auto-deploy, or modify secrets.
